courses.overview: 由車載訊息、被動觀測與安全責任連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect vehicle messages, passive observation and safety responsibility to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 工控網路分區與隔離
related.why: 可移植「車載功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from vehicle function maps; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「車載功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from vehicle function maps; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理車載訊息、被動觀測與安全責任；「工控網路分區與隔離」主要處理OT 區域、通道與不中斷的防禦證據，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes vehicle messages, passive observation and safety responsibility; Industrial-control network segmentation emphasizes ot zones, conduits and non-disruptive defensive evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「車用網路安全監測」與「工控網路分區與隔離」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「週期基線」的對照方法至「流矩陣」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Vehicle-network security monitoring and Industrial-control network segmentation flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from periodic baselines to flow matrices, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 企業端點偵測與回應
related.why: 可移植「車載功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from vehicle function maps; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「車載功能圖」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from vehicle function maps; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理車載訊息、被動觀測與安全責任；「企業端點偵測與回應」主要處理端點事件、偵測證據與核准回應，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes vehicle messages, passive observation and safety responsibility; Enterprise endpoint detection and response emphasizes endpoint events, detection evidence and approved response. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「車用網路安全監測」與「企業端點偵測與回應」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「週期基線」的對照方法至「時間排序」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Vehicle-network security monitoring and Enterprise endpoint detection and response flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from periodic baselines to time ordering, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

history.title: 現代車輛資安最佳實務 2022
history.text: 本課的公開資料脈絡包括「現代車輛資安最佳實務 2022」與「UN R155 車輛資安管理」。課程把介面和原理改寫為自行設定的對照練習，沒有重製文章、圖像或來源算例。
history.textEn: Public context includes Modern-vehicle cybersecurity best practices 2022 and UN R155 vehicle cybersecurity management. The course turns interfaces/principles into independently assumed comparisons without reproducing articles, artwork or source examples.
